beats.headline: Left behind after the panel
beats.text: On the way to his CrawlCon panel, Carl was walked through a studio where an older dwarf with a CrawlCon badge, Dr. Ratchet, was preparing a demonstration at a workbench beside a quarter-sized dwarven automaton. He needed the room's juice, so Carl would have to go upstairs; then he called after him: good luck, and keep your head down. After the panel, the studio is empty except for one table. Automaton Table. Level 5. On it lies Dr. Ratchet's Guide to Building Automatons for Fun and Profit. Carl takes the table and the guide into his inventory.

beats.headline: Ask the lawyer first
beats.text: Carl's legal question for his attorney is still unanswered, and Mordecai does not know either. Ask your lawyer, Mordecai says, and if he doesn't respond, wait until after the next recap episode. If they don't take it away from you, install it in the crafting studio and start working.

beats.headline: Not much use yet
beats.text: The level-five table is not much use yet, despite a manual full of recipes. Carl has been terrified they would take the table or the recipes back, since he basically stole them from the production facility, but nobody has said a word. The trouble is parts. Then he finally finds the materials for something called Spider Stalkers.

beats.headline: Much too close
beats.text: The hunters come running straight at the party, leading two of the explosive spiders right into their laps, and Carl scrambles into his interface to disable them. Before he can, Kiwi and Mongo fly over him and pounce on the pair, two tentacle-faced Saccathians with mechanical enhancements on their legs, who die screaming. The spider automatons stop dead, turn back around, and go looking for new targets.

beats.headline: Parts for a fabricator
beats.text: A platinum, dog-shaped Tserendolgor box opens with more supplies for the automaton table, and this one is an XL box, so the chest is bigger than last time. Carl knows from the instruction manual that the XL boxes contain parts for a fabricator, something he has been hoping to build for a while. He pulls it all into his inventory.

beats.headline: Katia at the table
beats.text: Responsibilities are finally being shared out, Florin falling right into the position of general. Carl has given Katia access to his automaton table, and she is working at it right now, building something for Tran to use now that his wheelchair is gone. She has bigger plans than that. They are going to need vehicles, and she is getting the ball rolling.

relations.note: Carl copies Dr. Ratchet's recipes into it
